item.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'pwd; cat TASK.md; cat solution.py; cat test_public.py'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 -B - <<'PY'
from solution import TTLCache
for cap in [True,False,0,-1,1.0,None,'2']:
    try: TTLCache(cap,lambda:0)
    except ValueError: pass
    else: raise AssertionError(cap)
now=[0]
c=TTLCache(2,lambda:now[0])
c.set('a',None,2); c.set('b',False,10)
assert c.get('a','miss') is None
c.set('c',0,10)
assert c.get('b','miss')=='miss'
assert c.get('c','miss')==0
now[0]=2
assert len(c)==1
c.set('c','',10); assert c.get('c','miss')==''
c.set('d',1,10)
for ttl in [True,False,-1,float('nan'),float('inf'),-float('inf'),'1',None]:
    before=list(c.items.items())
    try: c.set('c',2,ttl)
    except ValueError: pass
    else: raise AssertionError(ttl)
    assert list(c.items.items())==before
c.set('c',3,10); assert c.get('d')==1
c.set('c',4,0); assert c.get('c','miss')=='miss'
now[0]=12
assert c.get('absent') is None and len(c)==0
print('Additional normal-case checks passed')
c=TTLCache(1,lambda:0.0)
c.set('existing',1,10)
try:
    c.set('new',2,10**400)
except Exception as exc:
    print('Large finite integer TTL:',type(exc).__name__,str(exc))
    print('Cache contents after failed insertion:',c.items)
PY
nl -ba solution.py"
